description: Provided authentication token is missing, expired, or cryptographically invalid.
troubleshooting: Verify user credentials, renew bearer token, or initiate browser sign-in flow.

description: One-time authorization code or link has expired.
troubleshooting: Request a new authorization code or verification email.

description: One-time authorization code has already been redeemed.
troubleshooting: Initiate a new authentication attempt; one-time codes cannot be reused.

description: Authorization code presented does not match the requested purpose.
troubleshooting: Ensure code exchange matches the original OAuth or verification intent.

description: Configured local development sign-in user is missing or ambiguous.
troubleshooting: Check database seed state and ensure development user is present.

description: Provided authorization code is malformed or invalid.
troubleshooting: Check code input for transcription errors and try again.

description: OAuth token exchange or verification with external provider failed.
troubleshooting: Verify OAuth app client ID, secret, callback URL, and provider service status.

description: Requested authentication provider is not enabled on this server instance.
troubleshooting: Check server environment configuration for enabled auth providers.

description: External identity is already linked to another user account.
troubleshooting: Sign in to the existing account holding this external identity or unlink it first.

description: An account already exists for the specified email address.
troubleshooting: Sign in using existing credentials or use password reset.

description: Target user account has been suspended.
troubleshooting: Contact workspace administrator to review account status.

description: Authenticated user does not match required resource owner.
troubleshooting: Sign in with an account that possesses access permissions for this resource.

description: Too many requests submitted within rate limit window.
troubleshooting: Wait for the rate limit duration to elapse before making additional attempts.

description: Delivery of instant messaging payload failed during dispatch.
troubleshooting: Check target runtime connectivity, IM binding status, and worker logs.

description: Delivery execution exceeded configured operation deadline.
troubleshooting: Inspect computer runtime performance and check for slow model responses or blocking operations.

description: Queued delivery message exceeded maximum allowed queue age.
troubleshooting: Examine delivery worker throughput and scaling limits.

description: Delivery worker queue capacity saturated.
troubleshooting: Scale delivery worker concurrency or reduce concurrent active agent lane count.

description: Steer target delivery outcome is uncertain or cannot be correlated.
troubleshooting: Verify root turn status and check whether previous turn settled cleanly.

description: Message delivery reached terminal rejection and will not be re-attempted.
troubleshooting: Inspect delivery payload schema and verify target agent binding validity.

description: Delivery deferred due to active execution custody by another worker.
troubleshooting: Normal concurrency behavior; candidate will be re-evaluated on next scheduler pass.

description: Steer delivery deferred because turn execution has not reached admissible phase.
troubleshooting: Wait for active turn to reach steerable state.

description: Delivery computer placement is stale or generation has advanced.
troubleshooting: Check session computer placement table for updated runner instances.

description: IM provider integration is temporarily unavailable or unreachable.
troubleshooting: Check outbound network connectivity and external IM platform status.

description: IM binding configuration conflicts with existing channel or workspace mapping.
troubleshooting: Review channel and team bindings in workspace settings.

description: IM provider rejected interaction due to permission or authorization constraints.
troubleshooting: Ensure OpenTag app has required scopes and permissions in Slack or Lark/Feishu.

description: IM binding credential generation is superseded by a newer version.
troubleshooting: Fetch the latest binding state and use current generation credentials.

description: Specified IM binding record does not exist.
troubleshooting: Verify binding ID and ensure integration was not uninstalled.

description: Cannot alter immutable provider type on an existing IM binding.
troubleshooting: Create a new binding for the desired provider instead of modifying an existing one.

description: IM provider requires workspace re-authorization due to updated scopes.
troubleshooting: Navigate to integration settings and complete OAuth re-authorization.

description: Action requires unbinding existing IM integration first.
troubleshooting: Unbind current provider before attaching a new configuration.

description: Target Feishu/Lark app is already bound to another agent.
troubleshooting: Use a distinct Feishu app or unbind it from previous agent.

description: Feishu tenant or app identity does not match existing binding record.
troubleshooting: Verify app ID, app secret, and workspace tenant.

description: Feishu/Lark API endpoint returned 5xx error or connection failed.
troubleshooting: Check Feishu platform status and retry with backoff.

description: Slack app team workspace is already bound to an agent.
troubleshooting: Select an unbound Slack team or reconfigure existing agent.

description: Slack OAuth payload is missing required team or user identification.
troubleshooting: Re-run Slack OAuth installation flow ensuring all required scopes are granted.

description: Slack API rejected bot or user token.
troubleshooting: Re-authenticate Slack integration to obtain fresh token.

description: Slack team ID does not match expected binding tenant.
troubleshooting: Ensure OAuth connection was made to the correct Slack workspace.

description: Slack integration configuration conflicts with existing settings.
troubleshooting: Review channel and team configuration for duplicate records.

description: Slack OAuth token exchange failed.
troubleshooting: Check Slack client ID, client secret, redirect URI, and network connectivity.

description: Slack integration requires re-authorization to acquire missing scopes.
troubleshooting: Re-install Slack app to update permissions.

description: Slack API is unreachable or returned server error.
troubleshooting: Check Slack status page and retry with exponential backoff.

description: Uncaught exception or unhandled rejection triggered immediate process termination.
troubleshooting: Inspect fatal error stack in Cloud Logging to identify root cause.

description: Unhandled internal server condition encountered.
troubleshooting: Check server diagnostic logs and error report relay for detailed traces.

description: Server or upstream dependency is temporarily unavailable.
troubleshooting: Verify database health, network connectivity, and external dependencies.

description: Outbound HTTP request was blocked by SSRF egress policy (private or loopback IP).
troubleshooting: Verify destination URL resolves to a public routable IP address.

description: Requested Model Context Protocol server configuration not found.
troubleshooting: Verify MCP server ID and ensure it is registered in catalog.

description: MCP operation exceeded configured timeout deadline.
troubleshooting: Check MCP server response latency and increase timeout if necessary.

description: MCP server refused authentication credentials.
troubleshooting: Verify API key, OAuth token, or basic auth credentials for the target MCP server.

description: MCP server requires additional authorization scopes.
troubleshooting: Re-authorize MCP server with requested permission scopes.

description: Unsupported authorization type configured for MCP server.
troubleshooting: Configure a supported authorization method (OAuth2, bearer token, API key).

description: MCP credential input validation failed.
troubleshooting: Verify format and character limits of submitted MCP credentials.

description: Configured MCP authentication header format is invalid.
troubleshooting: Use standard HTTP header formatting without forbidden characters.

description: MCP OAuth authorization flow is corrupt or invalid.
troubleshooting: Restart MCP OAuth flow from the beginning.

description: MCP OAuth session expired before user completed authorization.
troubleshooting: Initiate a new OAuth authorization flow and complete promptly.

description: User or administrator denied MCP OAuth authorization request.
troubleshooting: Accept requested scopes on OAuth consent screen to enable integration.

description: MCP OAuth token exchange failed.
troubleshooting: Verify OAuth endpoint settings and provider operational status.

description: Dynamic client registration is not supported by target MCP server.
troubleshooting: Manually register client credentials with the MCP provider.

description: Dynamic client registration with MCP server failed.
troubleshooting: Inspect MCP server error response and check registration parameters.

description: Requested transport protocol is not supported for MCP connection.
troubleshooting: Use standard SSE or HTTP POST transport as supported by MCP gateway.

description: MCP protocol version incompatibility detected.
troubleshooting: Upgrade MCP server implementation to supported protocol specification.

description: Target MCP server endpoint is unreachable.
troubleshooting: Verify MCP server network availability and DNS resolution.

description: Target MCP server returned an upstream HTTP 5xx error.
troubleshooting: Review MCP server logs to determine cause of server-side failure.

description: Health probe or capability discovery failed for MCP server.
troubleshooting: Verify MCP endpoint responds to standard discovery requests.

description: Credential refresh outcome could not be reliably verified.
troubleshooting: Inspect database connection and retry credential refresh.

description: Requested agent skill definition not found.
troubleshooting: Verify skill identifier and check agent skill assignment.

description: Specified skill preset is not installed or available in catalog.
troubleshooting: Check skill preset registry and ensure preset package is deployed.

description: Skill name conflicts with an existing skill on this agent.
troubleshooting: Choose a unique name for the skill.

description: Concurrent modification conflict detected on skill revision.
troubleshooting: Reload skill definition and reapply edits on latest revision.

description: Agent has reached the maximum allowed number of skills.
troubleshooting: Remove unused skills before attaching new ones.

description: Specified skill name uses a reserved system identifier.
troubleshooting: Choose a different name that does not collide with built-in commands.

description: Skill source payload or manifest failed validation.
troubleshooting: Validate SKILL.md format and manifest metadata.

description: External repository or source URL for skill could not be reached.
troubleshooting: Verify network access to git repository or HTTP skill source.

description: Skill source destination blocked by egress security policy.
troubleshooting: Ensure source URL points to public repository and not private network.

description: Skill source archive or file size exceeds maximum limit.
troubleshooting: Reduce size of skill assets and dependencies.

description: No valid skill definitions discovered in source target.
troubleshooting: Ensure source repository contains SKILL.md files in recognized locations.

description: Skill storage or database table temporarily inaccessible.
troubleshooting: Check database connectivity and retry skill operation.

description: Client or runner runtime protocol version is incompatible with server.
troubleshooting: Update OpenTag client or server so protocol versions align.

description: Requested capability is not supported by target runtime connection.
troubleshooting: Verify computer capabilities and update client CLI.

description: Malformed or out-of-sequence protocol frame received.
troubleshooting: Inspect websocket frames for schema non-compliance or unexpected sequence numbers.

description: Runtime connection handshake authentication timed out.
troubleshooting: Ensure computer daemon connects and authenticates within timeout window.

description: Runtime session registration exceeded deadline.
troubleshooting: Check runner container launch latency and network latency to server.

description: Session pagination cursor is invalid or expired.
troubleshooting: Reset cursor and fetch from latest known checkpoint.

description: Cryptographic proof presented for session admission is invalid.
troubleshooting: Re-issue session proof from authorized controller.

description: Client received an HTTP response that failed schema validation.
troubleshooting: Inspect server API response for unexpected structure or version mismatch.

description: Client attempted mutating request without required double-submit CSRF cookie.
troubleshooting: Ensure browser cookies are enabled and refresh page to obtain CSRF cookie.

description: Client network transport failed before receiving response.
troubleshooting: Check client internet connectivity and verify server reachable.

description: Client request was aborted or cancelled by user.
troubleshooting: Retry the operation if the cancellation was unintended.
